android.desc:
Redact is the fastest way to mass delete your social media history. Bulk delete tweets, Discord messages, Reddit posts and Facebook posts across all your accounts - in minutes, not months. The social media cleaner that cleans up old posts so you don't have to scroll back through years of them.

DELETE TWEETS & X POSTS

A fast tweet deleter and tweet eraser. Bulk delete tweets, delete old tweets, replies, likes and Twitter/X DMs. Mass delete tweets from your last 30 days free, or go Premium to clear years of history in minutes. Delete Twitter likes, delete Twitter DMs and mass delete X posts from one screen.

MASS DELETE DISCORD MESSAGES

Redact is a Discord message deleter and Discord cleaner. Mass delete Discord messages across your servers, delete all Discord messages in a channel, or clear Discord DMs in bulk. Your last 30 days are free - Premium clears your full Discord history.

BULK DELETE YOUR REDDIT HISTORY

Wipe Reddit posts and Reddit comments for free - clear your Reddit history from the past 30 days at no cost. Editing Reddit posts and comments and clearing Reddit chat messages requires Premium.

MASS DELETE FACEBOOK POSTS

A Facebook post deleter and Facebook comment deleter in one. Mass delete Facebook posts, photos and comments, or bulk delete old Facebook posts to clean up your timeline. Free for your last 30 days.

CLEAN UP INSTAGRAM

Delete Instagram posts and comments from your last 30 days free. Premium unlocks Instagram messages, likes, saved collections and mass unfollow.

30+ MORE PLATFORMS

Bluesky, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Slack and more - all from one app.

Mass delete from Disqus, Imgur, Bumble, Github and Yelp from the mobile app.

Access more bulk deletion platforms and features on our desktop app.

WHY REDACT

• Bulk delete old posts by date range, keyword, or content type
• Preview exactly what will be removed before you delete
• Built for privacy - clean up your digital footprint locally on your device
• Find your exposed data from over 200+ sites
• Scan and review content before running deletions
• Save your content locally during or before deletion with the archive feature

START FREE

Redact's free plan covers your last 30 days of content on Facebook, Discord, Twitter/X, Reddit and Instagram. 

Upgrade to delete your entire history, unlock advanced platforms and automate recurring cleanups. See full plan details at redact.dev/pricing.

quotes.story_title: Archive your Reddit data before it's too late
